data.narrative: Completed Module 4 observability - chose JSON everywhere for log format (consistency across environments), chose pull-based Prometheus for metrics approach (service exposes /metrics endpoint, scraper collects data). Implemented structured JSON logging with required fields (timestamp, level, message, request_id, service). Implemented Prometheus metrics with counters (http_requests_total) and histograms (http_request_duration_seconds). Defined three alert rules: HighErrorRate (5% threshold), HighLatency (p95 > 2s), ServiceDown (up==0). Fixed three BREAK issues: silent failure (added error logging), cardinality bomb (removed high-cardinality labels), missing request_id (fixed middleware).

dimension_scores.observation: Identified and fixed three observability failure modes: silent failure (error handler swallowing errors, metrics show problem but logs don't), cardinality bomb (high-cardinality labels causing metric explosion), missing request_id (middleware generating null IDs, disconnecting logs). Understood root causes: missing error logging, label cardinality, middleware timing.
dimension_scores.evidence: Break step diagnosis: 'Silent failure - error handler has try-catch that logs nothing. Cardinality bomb - metric label uses high-cardinality value like user_id. Missing request ID - middleware generates null/undefined'
